nodes.name: Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes: Receives submission data from Workflow A

nodes.name: Extract Manifest URL
nodes.notes: Normalizes webhook data and extracts manifestUrl to top level

nodes.name: Download 2A Manifest
nodes.notes: Downloads manifest from R2 to get approved poses

nodes.name: Preserve isFirstPass
nodes.notes: Preserves isFirstPass and other metadata from Extract Manifest URL after HTTP Request downloads manifest

nodes.name: Is First Pass?
nodes.notes: Routes items on first pass to submit loop, retry loop items continue to status check

nodes.name: Prep Incremental Manifest Upload
nodes.notes: Prepares updated manifest with Bria status for R2 upload

nodes.name: Upload Updated Manifest to R2
nodes.notes: Uploads updated manifest with Bria status so retry loop can find it

nodes.name: Restore JSON After Upload
nodes.notes: Restores JSON data after S3 upload (S3 node may strip fields)

nodes.name: Wait 90 Seconds
nodes.notes: Give Bria AI time to process images

nodes.name: Has statusUrl?
nodes.notes: After first pass, routes items with statusUrl to status check, items without to submit (shouldn't happen)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { job_id: $json.job_id, character_hash: $json.characterHash, stage: 'BRIA_READY', status: 'PAUSED_AWAITING_APPROVAL', poses_bg: $json.posesBg, qa: $json.qa, order_data: $json.orderData } }}

nodes.name: Build 2B Manifest
nodes.notes: Creates updated manifest with Bria processing results

nodes.name: Merge Before Webhook
nodes.notes: Merges DB write and webhook prep before final response
